question: What formal details and evidentiary certifications are required to submit an administrative complaint against erring BFP inspectors?
answer:
To submit an administrative complaint against erring BFP inspectors, the following details are required:

1. For complaints at the City/Municipal level, the citizen should provide the details via email or other form of communication to the Customer Relations Officer (CRO) at the City/Municipal Fire Station level [S2]. No specific evidentiary certifications are mentioned in the provided sources.

2. For complaints at the BFP Regional and Provincial/District Offices, the citizen can call the attention of the Regional, Provincial and District Fire Marshal or their authorized representative staff officer or the Head of the Unit/Office concerned [S2]. Formal complaints may be coursed through the BFP NHQ IAS or the Regional IAS, but the sources do not specify the required formal details or evidentiary certifications.

Regarding the prohibition of BFP personnel from engaging in impropriety and/or corruption, there is no specific mention of required details or evidentiary certifications for such complaints in the provided sources [S1]. It is advisable to refer to the BFP Memorandum Circular No. 2016-016 for more details.

For city planning-related adjustments and appeals, the sources do not provide details on the required formal details or evidentiary certifications [S3]. It is recommended to refer to the City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II for more details.
